messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager duty alert  P0: GPU pool saturation (us-west-2) — autoscaler failing to scale up, queue growth detected. Triggered at 02:17 UTC. Pager ID PD-4862
pagerduty: @ana_oncall you have been paged for PD-4862 (ack to claim)
ana_oncall: acked — jumping in. seeing 5xx spikes on hosted-api/us-west and queued jobs backlog. Anyone else seeing throttles? :eyes:
josh_sre: seeing the same — metrics: queued_requests ~ 12k (baseline 200-400), pool utilization 98%, scale-up events firing but no new nodes added. controller logs show repeated "scale rejected: threshold_mismatch"
mei_runtime: I'm pulling autoscaler logs now. quick grep: `grep -i threshold_mismatch /var/log/autoscaler/* | tail -n 50` — there's a new regression in the threshold comparator introduced in last deploy (deploy-bot: 2025-11-02T01:50Z).
sami_platform: hold on, we rolled a config tweak to autoscaler thresholds at 01:45Z to tighten scale decisions for cost. Could be related. Reverting is possible but will need manual approval.
lina_infra: capacity-wise we have spare node quota in us-west-2, can spin up +8 g4dn nodes if needed (it will take ~6-8 min to provision).
kyle_support: customer-impact: three enterprise tenants (acme, baker, zeta) reporting high latencies and some 5xx errors. Acme's SLO alerts triggered. They called support.
rai_product: noted — I'll coordinate customer communications once we have a mitigation and ETA.
deploy-bot: deploy 2025-11-02T01:50Z autoscaler-service:v2.14 succeeded on canary and rolled to 90% (id: dpl-98331)
ana_oncall: immediate mitigations options? 1) revert config/rollout, 2) force scale manually, 3) route traffic to eu region, 4) enable fallback model for affected routes. Prioritize fast recovery.
josh_sre: agreeing: manual forced scale + pause rollout should be fastest. Mei, can you open a quick rollback PR or pause the rollout?
mei_runtime: pausing rollout now — `kubectl -n infra rollout pause deployment/autoscaler-controller` — paused. Confirming no new async rollouts.
sami_platform: good call. I'll hold the release. Also toggling the stricter threshold flag off: `service-config autoscaler.threshold.strict=false` — applying now.
mei_runtime: changed config and reloaded controller: `systemctl restart autoscaler-controller` — logs show comparator back to previous code path. Watching behavior.
josh_sre: triggering manual scale: `infractl scale gpu-pool us-west-2 --add 8` — started provisioning nodes. Lina, can you confirm provider side?
lina_infra: provider accepted allocation request id alloc-7421, sloting up. ETA ~7m. Meanwhile I'll start evicting best-effort jobs from the pool to free KV cache: `evict --label priority=best-effort`
ana_oncall: routing note: enabling traffic diversion for low-tier customers to eu fallback for read-only endpoints. Sami, are routing rules ready?
sami_platform: pushing routing change: `routectl divert --from hosted-api/us-west-2 --to hosted-api/eu-west-1 --match tenant_tier=free` — applied. Monitoring for downstream latencies.
kyle_support: acme updated: "we're seeing intermittent failures but thanks for the heads up" — they'll stay on standby for an update in 15m.
mei_runtime: good sign: autoscaler comparators no longer emitting "threshold_mismatch". Controller now reporting recent scale decisions accepted. Queue is slowly decreasing from 12k -> 9.2k in last 3m.
josh_sre: provisioning complete — nodes joined the pool. New utilization down to 76%. Queue falling. Throttles still happening for some requests but degraded compared to peak.
ana_oncall: summary so far: root cause suspected config change in autoscaler threshold logic rolled at 01:50Z. Immediate remediation: paused rollout, reverted config, restarted controller, forced +8 nodes, evicted best-effort jobs, diverted free-tier traffic. Impact: high latency and 5xx for some tenants for ~18m window.
rai_product: drafting customer note: will send a short heads-up to impacted customers now and offer postmortem once we have full timeline.
josh_sre: can we add a safety check to block future rollout if queued_requests > 1k? That's a simple guard.
sami_platform: noted — I'll add a rollout precondition in the pipeline: require queue < 1k or autoscaler healthcheck ok. Will open PR after incident stabilized.
lina_infra: infra action: increase warm standby pool from 2 -> 4 in us-west-2 for next 48h to reduce cold-provision time. Will schedule change with cost owners.
ana_oncall: we're stabilizing; queue down to 3.1k and error rate falling. putting incident into mitigation -> monitoring. Handing to SRE rotation for post-incident analysis. Josh, Mei, Sami stay on for postmortem doc.
josh_sre: assigning postmortem owner: @josh_sre. Mei and Sami co-authors. Action items logged in ticket INC-8672.
kyle_support: customers notified. One wants SLA credit assessment — capturing in INC-8672.
rai_product: postmortem should include timeline, root cause (config regression), blast radius (tenants impacted), action items (rollout gate, extra warm standby, revert testing), and follow-up ETA.
mei_runtime: quick note: debug log excerpt:
```
[01:50:12] comparator.go:214: compareThresholds: a=0.12 b=0.08 -> reject scaleup (regression)
[01:50:13] autoscaler: scale decision: REJECTED reason="threshold_mismatch"
[02:17:01] controller: rollout applied v2.14 config-strict=true
```

josh_sre: nice capture. We'll include that in the postmortem. Also recommend a canary window and automated smoke test that simulates queued requests > 2k to detect scale regressions earlier.
sami_platform: I'll own rollout gating and add CI smoke test that exercises queue-to-scale path. PR targeting next sprint.
ana_oncall: handing to oncall-next: @josh_sre will follow through with postmortem and action items; oncall rotation note: current oncall will monitor for next 2h then formally close.
deploy-bot: rollback dpl-98331 flagged as manual, no automated rollback performed.
kyle_support: logging customer follow-ups in CRM.
josh_sre: Post-incident action list (short):
- Add rollout precondition for queued_requests < 1k (owner: sami_platform, ETA: 3d)
- Add autoscaler canary test simulating queue load (owner: mei_runtime, ETA: 5d)
- Increase warm standby in us-west-2 for 48h (owner: lina_infra, ETA: 1h)
- SLA impact assessment and customer credits (owner: kyle_support, ETA: 2d)
- Update runbook with "threshold_mismatch" triage steps (owner: ana_oncall, ETA: 2d)

ana_oncall: adding runbook note: if comparator returns threshold_mismatch after a deploy, pause rollout, revert config flag, and force scale if queue > 2k.
mei_runtime: I'll attach controller logs and the failing comparator tests to INC-8672.
sami_platform: opening PR for pipeline precondition now: PR#1147.
josh_sre: we'll schedule a 30m postmortem sync in 2h to go over timeline and finalize writeup. For now, monitoring looks good. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
ana_oncall: incident status -> mitigated; moving to post-incident review. Closing pager. :white_check_mark:
